text:
Katie Nguyen: Heads up — syncing cross-team deps for the pricing/packaging change. Need owners for metering schema, billing adapter, quota enforcement, and contract flagging. Plan: freeze API on Mon 3/30, canary rollout Thu 4/2. Who's owning each?

Alex Park: I'll take metering schema. PR up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/942 — needs review from eng-infra and devex.

Cheng Li: Billing adapter is on me, but blocked by the invoice schema change from finance. Adding mock events today, ETA EOD Wednesday.

Morgan Blake: Quota enforcement requires a feature flag in auth-service. I can implement flag + small migration, but need a rubric from product for hard/soft limits. @Katie could you share the matrix?

Rahul Desai: I can do contract/contract flagging + legal kick-off. Need final wording; looping in Jordan.

Jordan (Legal): On it — will review the contract note by tomorrow. FYI we need a clause for data residency for some enterprise customers.

BillingBot: Billing adapter test run scheduled for 2026-04-01T02:00Z. Results posted to #eng-releases when complete.

Katie Nguyen: Thanks — quick asks: (1) Alex, can you tag the metering tests with `pricing:beta` so we can run evals? (2) Cheng, ping finance for invoice schema doc — @morgan we can use the draft matrix in the product confluence link: https://confluence.redwood/packaging/quota-matrix

Alex Park: Yep tagging now. Tests limited to 10k events.

Cheng Li: Pinged finance in thread — @Ellen_f (finance) please drop the invoice schema link here.

Morgan Blake: Confirmed I have the draft. Will share quick table in this thread by EOD.

Katie Nguyen: OK — post any blockers here. If nothing critical by Wed noon we'll proceed with freeze and start canary on Thu. :thumbsup:

Alex Park: approving review requested from @cheng for metering interface.

Cheng Li: Review done, left minor comments. LGTM after fixes.

Rahul Desai: Contract wording updated, uploaded v1 to confluence. Jordan acked.

Jordan (Legal): Acked. Minor phrasing tweak, no blockers.

BillingBot: Billing pipeline smoke OK — details: run_id=20260401-01, failures=0.

Katie Nguyen: Nice. Closing open items: metering PR -> Alex to merge after CI, billing adapter -> Cheng to deploy to staging Thursday morning, quota flag -> Morgan to toggle in canary region. Thanks all.
